services.name: Contemporary Chicago Blues ~LIVE~ with Michael Charles!!
services.desc: Kick-off your week and join us for a 2-hour concert sail from 7pm-9pm every Monday this Summer. About We’ll help you chase your Monday BLUES away aboard the 148-foot Tall Ship Windy as you enjoy the breathtaking views of Chicago from the waters of Lake Michigan accompanied by the sweet sounds of the blues. Whether you're a long-time fan or a newcomer to the blues, you're sure to be transported by the talent and passion of each amazing artist. With a full bar and a friendly, knowledgeable crew, you'll be able to relax and enjoy the music in comfort and style. Each concert will bring a unique twist to the blues genre, showcasing the diversity and versatility of this legendary music form.

blurb: Guests sail aboard a 148-foot, four-masted schooner to enjoy views of the Chicago skyline and Lake Michigan. The experience includes public sails, fireworks cruises, live music sails, group outings, and private charters. The ship departs conveniently from Navy Pier and offers a relaxed, photo-friendly way to enjoy the city from the water.
